name: Tilapia with Cilantro-Orange Zucchini & Bell Pepper Sauté over Rice
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and large dice zucchini; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle cornstarch, salt, and pepper over both sides, pressing gently to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tilapia and cook, flipping once, until crispy and easily flakes with a fork, about 6 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil; set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into a small bowl.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the orange juice, along with broth, soy sauce, additional cornstarch, and spices. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and sauté until fork-tender, 6-7 minutes.
Add sauce to the skillet with the veggies; continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce is thickened, about 1 minute.
To serve, divide rice, tilapia, veggies, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
